It uses 3 fields actually—exceeds 2 fields limit). To comply with KEEP_IN_MIND2, implement pairwise averaging: average(star FY1 zscore and F12M zscore). Chose two-field variant to respect limits. Confidence: 0.63

results.idea: TS rank of residual between star surprise and F12M estimate trend
results.description: Compute residual subtract(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, ts_regression(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps, 126)) then ts_rank—practicality: ts_regression returns complex output; to keep implementation short we use ts_corr as proxy. Two fields used. Confidence: 0.56

results.idea: Surprise divided by winsorized F12M EPS with tiny floor
results.description: Divide star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1 by winsorize(add(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps,1e-6)) to avoid division instability. Two fields used; safety applied. Confidence: 0.61

results.idea: TS zscore of model consensus spread to find regime shifts
results.description: ts_zscore(abs(subtract(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, mdl30_psprise_pct_fy1_eps)), 126) to detect rising disagreement. Two fields used. Confidence: 0.57

results.idea: Short-term surprise spike confirmed by model consensus
results.description: multiply(zscore(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1), zscore(mdl30_psprise_pct_fy1_eps)) to require both models to be high. Two fields used. Confidence: 0.64

results.idea: Normalize surprise by recent absolute mean change
results.description: divide(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, ts_mean(abs(ts_delta(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1,1)), 60)) to find surprises relative to recent average move. Single-field nested TS ops. Confidence: 0.56

results.idea: TS target TVR hump on surprise to control turnover
results.description: ts_target_tvr_hump(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, lambda_min=0, lambda_max=1, target_tvr=0.1) used to create stable tradable signal from star surprise. Single field; operator available. Confidence: 0.55

results.idea: Inverse surprise for mean-reversion trades
results.description: reverse(zscore(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1)) to short recent high surprises expecting pullback. Single field. Confidence: 0.52

results.idea: TS returns divided by long-run std (momentum Sharpe)
results.description: divide(ts_returns(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps, 60), ts_std_dev(ts_returns(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps, 21), 252)) approximates momentum Sharpe of estimates. Single field nested TS ops. Confidence: 0.53

results.idea: Average of recent zscores of FY1 surprise and FY2 surprise
results.description: divide(add(zscore(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1), zscore(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy2)), 2) to capture cross-horizon corroboration while using only allowed fields. Two fields used. Confidence: 0.62

results.idea: TS rank of surprise divided by F12M estimate to capture normalized extreme
results.description: ts_rank(divide(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, add(mdl30_new_smartestimate_f12m_eps,1e-6)), 90) ranks extreme normalized surprises in time. Two fields used. Confidence: 0.61

results.idea: Surprise growth consistency: sign of TS correlation across windows
results.description: sign(ts_corr(star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy1, star_eps_surprise_prediction_fy2, 60)) to detect consistent directional agreement across horizons. Single-field pair operation. Confidence: 0.58
